title: Bring a background job to the foreground
summary: Use the `fg` command to bring a suspended or background job back to the foreground so you can interact with it directly in your terminal.

steps.explain: Bring the most recently suspended or running background job to the foreground.
Bring a specific job to the foreground by its job number. Use `jobs` to find the job number if you don't know it.

placeholders.name: JOB_NUMBER
placeholders.description: The job number of the background process you want to bring to the foreground.
